channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Dengue fever cases rise in Tampa Bay area as Pasco County ramps up mosquito control efforts
item.description: Florida reports 41 dengue fever cases, including 30 in Hillsborough County and 2 in Pasco County. Learn how to protect yourself and what officials are doing to help.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Army Secretary Dan Driscoll is stepping down, White House says
item.description: Secretary of the Army Dan Driscoll is stepping down, the White House confirmed on Monday. The Trump administration did not give a reason for Driscoll's departure.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 'Every little bit helps': In Polk County, Dolly’s books need a boost
item.description: Dolly Parton’s Imagination Library has paused new registrations in Polk County as United Way of Central Florida seeks more funding, leaving families on a waiting list for free monthly books.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] The shock gloves ICE plans to use could increase the risk of sudden death
item.description: ICE approved a deal last week to buy 6,650 electric shock gloves that deliver a low voltage shock upon contact with skin. Their manual warns their use may increase the risk of sudden death.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] FTC sues Amazon, alleging it overcharged advertisers
item.description: The FTC and 22 states on Monday accused retail giant Amazon of deceiving businesses by overcharging prices to advertise on its massive retail platform, pocketing billions for the company.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Permits for automated license plate readers revoked: FDOT
item.description: The Florida Department of Transportation said it revoked statewide permits for automated license plate recognition (LPR) systems.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Met drops John Galliano exhibit following criticism over antisemitic remarks
item.description: The Metropolitan Museum of Art is canceling its planned exhibit honoring designer John Galliano following backlash over the designer’s past antisemitic statements.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Tampa woman warns of fentanyl dangers after losing husband and stepson in less than a year
item.description: A Tampa woman is sharing her story after losing her husband and stepson to fentanyl overdoses less than a year apart.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Six more dachshunds rescued from ‘hoarding’ situation as 21 continue to recover in Tampa
item.description: A Tampa non-profit said it saved six dachshunds over the weekend from a hoarding situation — and that these dogs are related to the 21 others who were surrendered to Pinellas County Animal Services last week.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Tampa rapper murder trial: Inmate testifies about alleged jailhouse letters
item.description: A fellow inmate testified about an alleged cover-up scheme in the murder trial of Tampa rapper Billy Adams.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] University of Tampa requiring students to take new generative AI class, starting this fall
item.description: As classes kicked off for the fall semester at the University of Tampa Monday, sophomores are returning to campus with a brand new class on their schedule – and it’s all about generative artificial intelligence (AI).

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Search for driver involved in hit-and-run crash with E-bike: SPPD
item.description: St. Petersburg Police are searching for a driver who is accused of hitting a man riding an e-bike early Monday morning.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Sarasota paid parking expansion remains frozen as leaders reset plans
item.description: A planned expansion of paid parking in the city of Sarasota remains on hold after business owners and residents voiced opposition.
